Selon un responsable américain, s’exprimant sous couvert d’anonymat, l’Iran sera aussi au menu de la rencontre, mais pas l’Ukraine.

articles.title: After Her Baby Was Buried Alive, a South Carolina Mother Wonders Why
articles.summary: Koah Sharp, nearly 1, was rescued alive this week in a rural patch of central South Carolina. In her first interview, Koah’s mother explains what happened.

articles.title: What to Know About Continued Flight Disruptions
articles.summary: After a nationwide ground stop Friday, travelers are still encountering snags, and it could take several days for flight schedules to return to normal.

articles.title: Judge Blocks Immediate Closure of East Potomac Park for Trump Golf Project
articles.summary: Judge Ana C. Reyes, who has been overseeing combative litigation, said the Trump administration would not be responsible for operating the course while the case proceeded.

articles.title: Unlike Other Countries, America’s Government Funds Its Air Infrastructure
articles.summary: Despite handling the most flights in the world, the United States’ air traffic systems rely on 1980s-era computer equipment.

articles.title: Stranded by planes, travelers turned to trains and automobiles.
articles.summary: People trying to find new ways to get to their destinations still encountered obstacles at the rental car counter and on Amtrak’s booking system.

articles.title: Ukraine : Volodymyr Zelensky évoque l’hypothèse américaine d’une adhésion de son pays à l’OTAN contre la cession du Donbass
articles.summary: Les envoyés de Donald Trump ont proposé à Kiev une adhésion à l’OTAN en échange de territoires dans le Donbass, ce que l’Ukraine ne prend pas au sérieux, tandis que Vladimir Poutine campe sur ses exigences territoriales.

articles.title: Ground Stop Highlights Chronic Vulnerabilities in Air Traffic System
articles.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration’s aging air traffic control infrastructure has had several disruptive failures in recent months, as officials have sought to make upgrades.

articles.title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos
articles.summary: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack.

articles.title: New Orleans port files $1m lawsuit over 'miracle on the Mississippi' tanker collision
articles.summary: The lawsuit filed by New Orleans officials also requests that the tanker involved in the collision with the cruise ship be seized and sold to pay for damages.

articles.title: SpaceX successfully catches top of huge Starship rocket for first time
articles.summary: The rocket stage was caught mid air using huge mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

articles.title: Trump Kept Out of Sight as F.A.A. Issued Flight Ground Stop
articles.summary: The F.A.A. called a rare halt on flights nationwide, but the president stayed away from cameras and issued social media posts on the entertainment industry and California’s Democratic governor.

articles.title: Defense Contractor L3Harris Was Behind Upgrade That Led to Ground Stop
articles.summary: The little-known defense giant does a lot of work for the Federal Aviation Administration and owns the equipment for the agency’s telecommunications network.

articles.summary: A former aide to James Comey at the F.B.I. said the government had engaged in a “harassment campaign” in its efforts to secure witness testimony.

articles.summary: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.

articles.title: Watch: Cruise ship overturns after collision with tanker in New Orleans
articles.summary: Around 130 people were rescued from a cruise ship after it was struck by a tanker while docked in New Orleans, Louisiana on Friday.

articles.title: Trump to Meet With Putin and Xi in China, With Nuclear Proliferation on the Agenda
articles.summary: The president plans to also discuss the war against Iran, but is not expected to bring up Russia’s war in Ukraine or the scandal that has engulfed Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Suspension des vols aux Etats-Unis : plus de 18 400 vols annulés vendredi et samedi alors que des perturbations persistent
articles.summary: Après l’annulation de 12 000 vols vendredi, ce sont plus de 6 400 trajets qui ont connu le même sort samedi. Les autorités, qui imputent la panne à des travaux sur des infrastructures vétustes, s’attendent à un retour à la normale d’ici à dimanche soir.

articles.title: House Democrats Open Inquiry After Incoming Lawmaker Accused of Sexual Harassment
articles.summary: The House Democratic campaign arm is looking into an allegation against Representative-elect Brian Poindexter of Ohio. His campaign says he “gave what he thought was an innocuous compliment to a volunteer.”

articles.title: What’s Behind the Trump-Huang Relationship?
articles.summary: President Trump’s show of support for Jensen Huang as he was under fire was a remarkable moment in a relationship that barely existed two years ago. Our White House correspondent Maggie Haberman explains how Mr. Trump came to see Mr. Huang as a modern-day Henry Ford.

articles.title: Au Québec, la contestation étudiante prend de la vigueur, inspirée par la mobilisation en France
articles.summary: Des milliers d’étudiants québécois ont pris part cette semaine à un mouvement de grève pour dénoncer la précarité de leurs conditions de vie. Motivés par le mouvement social français, les jeunes réclament également de meilleures conditions d’enseignement.

articles.title: As Congress Plans Investigations, White House Prepares Ferocious Response
articles.summary: The Trump administration has quietly been laying the groundwork for an aggressive all-out effort to thwart newly empowered Democrats’ attempts at oversight.

articles.title: Top Democrat Eyes Filibuster-Proof Budget Bill to Unlock Affordability Agenda
articles.summary: The lawmaker set to lead the House Budget Committee outlined Democrats’ options for forcing a negotiation with President Trump on an economic package to bring down living costs.
